rules.latestBeforeTx: harness rule: the worker's most recent delivery before the rating transaction (root ignored)
rules.lastUnderRoot: the last delivery under the proof's root
rules.uniformClosedPeriod: uniform guess among the worker's deliveries of the period that the root closes (expected value)
rules.lastOfClosedPeriod: the last delivery of the period that the root closes
rules.timeOfDayNearest: time of day, per rating: the delivery under the root whose time + lag is closest to the rating
rules.timeOfDayJoint: time of day, joint: least-squares assignment of a worker's ratings to its deliveries, two per delivery

rowFormats.ratings: [id, worker, slot, chain block, deliveries of the worker under the proof's root]
rowFormats.truthDeliveries: [order seq, customer's own delay, establishment's own delay] (slots)
